title: Unforeseen Groundwater Table Elevation at Basement B3

input.extracted_text:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
RFI Number: RFI-2026-002
Subject: Unforeseen High Water Table Elevation during Basement Level 3 Excavation
Contract Reference: CON-2026-GEO-004
Raised Date: 2026-02-18
Due Date: 2026-02-25
Status: open

QUESTION:
During final bulk excavation to formation level -11.50m ECD for Basement Level 3, continuous water seepage was encountered at elevation -9.80m ECD, which is 1.70m above the historical water table noted in Geotechnical Report GT-BOR-01. Current 4-inch sump pumps are overwhelmed. We request immediate authorization for continuous perimeter deep well dewatering.
